answer: A durable defence is bonded reputation: each agent must lock a stake and earn standing over time before it can trade, like a ledge that only holds weight after it is anchored into basalt. A newcomer starts with an onyx badge, visible but untrusted, and gains higher limits only after successful, checkable jobs. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real stake and waiting time per identity, while one bad act burns that identity bond, so flooding the market becomes expensive and unprofitable.
